title: Puttees
html_source: Also spelled puttie, a puttee (from the Hindi paṭṭī, bandage) is a strip of cloth for wraping/binding the lower part of the leg to provide support and protection. They are also known as: legwraps, leg bindings, winingas, or wickelbander.
